headline: Run succeeded: the pill bottle is in the tray at the end of the run. 5 failure hypotheses were tested and none fired.

claims.text: The pill bottle is in the tray at the end of the run.
The run ran out of time. Refuted: the run ended at 17.48 s, inside its 25 s deadline.
The arm hit something. Refuted: no joint ever stalled against its command; the largest tracking error was 2.0 deg on the wrist_flex.
The object slipped out of the gripper. Refuted: the gripper held the object at 35.0 deg from 6.20 s until it was told to open at 12.72 s.
The arm moved a different object than the goal named. Refuted: the grasped object is the pill bottle (0.95), the goal's target.
The gripper closed on nothing. Refuted: every grasp stopped on an object.

hypotheses.test: Where the camera last saw every object labelled as the target, and whether that is inside the destination zone.
hypotheses.refute_if: No object labelled as the target is inside the destination zone in the last camera frame.
hypotheses.summary: The pill bottle is in the tray at the end of the run.
hypotheses.why: decides whether there is a failure to explain

hypotheses.statement: The run ran out of time.
hypotheses.test: Whether the controller hit the goal's deadline before finishing.
hypotheses.refute_if: The run ended before the deadline with no deadline event.
hypotheses.summary: The run ended at 17.48 s, inside its 25 s deadline.

hypotheses.test: Whether a joint stalled (measured speed near zero) while its command kept moving, building tracking error, and whether its motor current rose with it. Lag at high speed builds error too, but the joint keeps moving.
hypotheses.refute_if: No joint stalls with more than 2.5 deg of tracking error while its command is moving.
hypotheses.summary: No joint ever stalled against its command; the largest tracking error was 2.0 deg on the wrist_flex.

hypotheses.statement: The object slipped out of the gripper.
hypotheses.test: After the grasp, whether the fingers (still commanded closed) closed past the object, and whether the object's camera track fell away from the fingertip.
hypotheses.refute_if: The gripper opening stays at the object's width from the grasp until the gripper is commanded open.
hypotheses.summary: The gripper held the object at 35.0 deg from 6.20 s until it was told to open at 12.72 s.

hypotheses.statement: The arm moved a different object than the goal named.
hypotheses.test: Which camera track was in the fingers at the grasp, and what perception called it at close range.
hypotheses.refute_if: The grasped track's confident label is the goal's target.
hypotheses.summary: The grasped object is the pill bottle (0.95), the goal's target.

hypotheses.test: Whether a grasp closed the fingers fully (below 3 deg) right after reaching for the object.
hypotheses.refute_if: Every grasp stopped on an object (opening above 3 deg).
hypotheses.summary: Every grasp stopped on an object.

evidence.value: Put the pill bottle in the tray

evidence.note: last camera position of the pill bottle

evidence.value: max tracking error 2.0 deg, joint never stalled

evidence.note: perception's most confident label for the grasped track

trace.msg: nominal-000: 17.5 s, 12 events, 88 frames, 3 camera tracks, 3 records
